Gokuldham Society members are busy preparing for Tapu Sena's Trending Fancy Dress Competition for Ganeshotsav. Each resident is determined to win the Best Performance award while strictly adhering to their promise of keeping their acts and costumes secret.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
